segments.text: Hey mom, I know you can't understand
I shake my head all night
The warm cheese smell you pull away from
I hate it just as much as you
I see you grab the cotton buds
And I know what's coming next
You clean them out, they're back in days
The drops, the wipes, the washes
They clear it up for a week
But the gunk always comes back
I just want it to stop
Fix my death from the inside
My ears just need a little help

fullText: Hey mom, I know you can't understand But my ears are burning And I need your hand They itch so deep inside I shake my head all night The warm cheese smell you pull away from I hate it just as much as you I see you grab the cotton buds And I know what's coming next You clean them out, they're back in days It never really ends I know you've tried, mom The drops, the wipes, the washes They clear it up for a week But the gunk always comes back I'm tired, mom Tired of the shaking Tired of the scratching I just want it to stop Want you a day, mom That's all I need Fix my death from the inside Let my ears be free I'm not ready to stop Puddling you on the sofa Please try it for me I'm still your puppy, mom My ears just need a little help Three, six, five day Guarantee Click below for me
